meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用常驻内核里的 DuckDB 或 Polars 处理数据:先探测文件大小和可用内存,再决定把计算放在内存、原地查询还是流式执行,产出查询结果、必要图表以及行数和耗时,并且不使用 pandas。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件,或做分组聚合、清洗、绘图时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv:按城市分组算平均订单金额
say.note: 先探测文件,再决定是否载入内存

say.text: 直接查 S3 上的 parquet,只取需要的列再聚合
say.note: DuckDB 可带投影读取远程文件

say.text: 用 numpy 检验这两组数据的分布差异是否显著
say.note: 在 Python 内核里做统计检验

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude analyzes data using DuckDB or Polars in a resident kernel, probes file size and free RAM before placing the computation, and returns query results plus row counts and timing, without using pandas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze CSV, Parquet or JSON data, or to do group-by aggregation, cleaning or plotting.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv: average order amount grouped by city
say_en.note: It probes the file, then places the work

say_en.text: Query the parquet on S3 directly, selecting only needed columns
say_en.note: DuckDB reads remote files with pushdown

say_en.text: Use numpy to test whether the two groups differ significantly
say_en.note: Runs a statistical test in the Python kernel
